name: u1-klipper-tmc-autotune
title: TMC Autotune for Snapmaker U1
author: Andrew McGregor and contributors; Snapmaker U1 adaptation contributors
description: Packages the current Klipper TMC Autotune source for a Snapmaker U1 upgraded to LDO-42STH48-2504MACF motors on the TMC2240 X/Y axes. It tunes X/Y only with the auto goal, enables configurable small-hysteresis mode, preserves sensorless homing, and leaves every writable registered TMC field available through Klipper's SET_TMC_FIELD console command.
tagline: X/Y-only TMC tuning for LDO 0.9-degree U1 motion motors.
attributions: Klipper TMC Autotune is copyright Andrew McGregor and contributors and is licensed under GPL-3.0. This package is based on upstream commit b6c7cfa98c2ef880812d5279a9117cbe67d6d4d5, which includes the TOFF persistence fix from a4f4daa0b3512b751bb95cd20759e36a4963c25f. The Snapmaker U1 adaptation adds Bespok3d packaging, an X/Y-only LDO motor configuration, a configurable small_hysteresis option, compatibility tests, and documentation. Complete corresponding source is available in the public fork.
